intro: The startup pivoted eleven times in one quarter. The last pivot left a trail of cryptic commit messages and a whiteboard nobody is allowed to erase.

puzzles.title: All Hands
puzzles.flavor: Recovered from the All Hands answering machine: two tones sounded together, and a few keys were tapped twice or thrice before the message moved on.

partials.fe61c9a64bd3d9527230f2723a30c0449cc22b94: So close. Exactly one thing is wrong here. Fix it (and remember what you fixed).

puzzles.hint: Each frequency pair is a phone keypad key (DTMF). The ×n is how many times it was pressed: old-school multi-tap texting.

puzzles.title: Monday Deploy
puzzles.flavor: The same quantities keep returning with different little marks beneath them; translate each into its own counting and then take its place along the alphabet.

partials.2ebc7e0ec81f301e5c82b5aa3b292e6411bddead: So close. Exactly one thing is wrong here. Fix it (and remember what you fixed).

puzzles.hint: Each number is a letter position written in the base shown in its subscript.

puzzles.title: Standup
puzzles.flavor: At standup someone knocks from the hallway: two raps, a held breath, three raps. The first burst chooses the row and the second the column on a five-by-five grid that has no place for J.

partials.ae49b4373638efa00720a589bca9c7ff47719c41: So close. Exactly one thing is wrong here. Fix it (and remember what you fixed).

puzzles.hint: Tap code: first burst = row, second = column, in a 5×5 grid without K.

puzzles.title: Hotfix
puzzles.flavor: Two forward and one across; keep the square where you land. The copyist had the alphabet up to a mirror, so reflect that letter back before speaking it.

blocks.text: The knight sets out from h8: Nf7 Ng5 Ne4 Nd6 Nb7 Nc5 Nd3.

partials.1dc0ede40a335c29b77f84d9e36fdb3390828c77: You've decoded it, but it's not finished. One more layer.
partials.bfef49430ec752ff481efaff284b204464a17173: So close. Exactly one thing is wrong here. Fix it (and remember what you fixed).

puzzles.hint: Start on the given square and follow the knight moves; read the letter on each square it lands on. Then undo: Atbash (A↔Z mirror).

puzzles.title: Burn Rate
puzzles.flavor: Every rung of the ladder is two switches set or clear; the engineers swear that three rungs together are where the chain first folds into a single letter.

partials.e3ad16beec7057fcc29364bb599b5c28fea3a569: So close. Exactly one thing is wrong here. Fix it (and remember what you fixed).

puzzles.hint: Pairs of bits are nucleotides (A=00, C=01, G=10, T=11). Six bits = one codon; translate codons to amino-acid one-letter codes.

puzzles.title: Runway
puzzles.flavor: The office photograph is of the negative, and the negative is hung upside down; read from the back, the right way up, in triplets, until the chain folds into letters.

partials.42f4906e5fffd55bbb93fa43651627503a5b11de: So close. Exactly one thing is wrong here. Fix it (and remember what you fixed).

puzzles.hint: This is the template (antisense) strand written 5′→3′. Reverse-complement it to get the coding strand, then translate codons to amino-acid one-letter codes.

meta.title: Meta: Series Z
meta.flavor: Each transmission reached the office with exactly one corrupted character; the true answer hides behind it, and the corruption—kept in turn—spells the final message.
